audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Mel 5 of 7 stages while Aurelion Sol wins 58.93% over 582 games, and win[4]/win[5]/win[6] disagree with phases[4].side/phases[5].side on disk.
audit.why: Astral Flight at 4 gives a flyby trade Mel cannot answer at her 250-range W, and the stardust curve plus Rod of Ages makes the post-item stages clearly his.
audit.corrected: Mel / Mel / Mel / Skill / Skill / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes referenced fabricated abilities: 'Shattering Bulwark', 'Golden Touch', 'Voice of Light', 'Q Starfire'.
audit.why: Riot kit: Mel W is Rebuttal, P is Searing Brilliance, R is Golden Eclipse; Aurelion Sol Q is Breath of Light and R is Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around Radiant Volley's 10s rank-1 cooldown, Rebuttal's 38/35/33/29/26s, and The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text said Rebuttal 'reflects your projectiles back' as the whole story and never mentioned Solar Snare cancelling Aurelion Sol's channels or Searing Brilliance's execute.
audit.why: Rebuttal prevents her taking damage outright (Riot text), so a Breath of Light channel into it is wasted whether or not it reflects. Solar Snare roots at 1000 range and both Breath of Light and Astral Flight are interruptible channels. Searing Brilliance executes on Overwhelm stacks, so HP-bar reads mislead.
audit.corrected: Stated the damage-prevention, the 1000-range root cancelling the channel, and the execute threshold across early/mid/late and the don'ts.

audit.why: Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 down to 26s at rank 5; Radiant Volley 10s down to 6s; Falling Star 120/110/100s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[1], mid, wants.you[2] and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated headings.
audit.why: The heading promises R usage and low-health discipline; the body described a flyby trade.
audit.corrected: Both replaced with content matching their trigger.

edits.before: Mel's Radiant Volley and Golden Touch punish you for approaching minions, chipping you down every time you go for CS with Q Starfire, so you're stuck farming from a distance while she out-trades every short-range exchange.
edits.after: Mel's Radiant Volley is up every 10s at rank 1 and Searing Brilliance stacks Overwhelm on every hit, so trading beam ticks for volleys feeds her Golden Eclipse — take CS at Q's 750 range and step back out.

edits.before: Mel's Shattering Bulwark reflects your incoming damage/CC back at you, so all-inning her right off her level 6 is dangerous — a mistimed Q-E combo can boomerang into your own face.
edits.after: Rebuttal blocks all damage for its duration and is up every 26s at rank 5, so a Falling Star cast into the glow buys her a free reset — stun her when it is spent, not before.

edits.before: Mel has no reliable escape from your Voice of Light ultimate's zone control, and once you have your full burst combo online you can flatten her before she gets enough poke stacked to matter — group fights favor your AoE over her single-target reflect.
edits.after: Mel has no dash and no escape from The Skies Descend, which drags her into the singularity where your Q burns her for the whole knockup — Rebuttal only covers 250 units around her, so it saves nobody once she is caught.

edits.before: Mel out-trades you at close range through her poke tools, so play the long game — farm with Q Starfire from max distance, don't contest every wave, and wait for her to overextend her shield-reflect timing before you commit any real damage.
edits.after: Mel out-trades you at close range with Radiant Volley, so play the long game — last-hit with Breath of Light at its 750 range, concede the wave, and only commit once Rebuttal is spent, because it blocks damage outright rather than reducing it.

edits.before: Respect her Shattering Bulwark around level 6 — throwing your full combo into an active reflect just kills you faster, so bait it out with a cheap spell first, then follow with your real engage once the shield's down.
edits.after: Respect Rebuttal around level 6 — it is a 26-38s cooldown that blanks a whole rotation, so bait it with a single Q tick, then land Falling Star and burn the stun with Breath of Light while she has no answer up.

edits.after: This flips hard late: The Skies Descend drags her whole side into one point and your Q burns them for the full duration, while Rebuttal's 250-unit bubble only saves Mel and only for a moment. Group for 5v5s once your core is done — she has no dash to leave the singularity.

edits.after: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, fly at her every 16s Astral Flight, and group early — she has no dash, so a lead over Mel converts straight into objective control.

edits.after: Carry by outlasting her: Golden Eclipse only cashes stacks she put on you, and stardust is permanent — the 30-minute you wins fights she cannot answer.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Mel for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Falling Star is your only self-peel — hold the 120s stun for her step-up or a jungler dive, not for wave clear or a greedy poke trade.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: Searing Brilliance executes on Overwhelm damage, so your health bar lies — below half, every beam tick you greed is her free kill.

notes: Mel is female; several full-layer fields still say 'his' (tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns wording, report[3].t, report[9].t) — those strings are duplicated verbatim in multiple fields so a pronoun-only sweep is safer done by a tool than by per-field edits here. Rebuttal's reflect: Riot's text says it reflects enemy projectiles AND prevents her taking damage; Breath of Light is a sustained beam channel, not a projectile, so whether it reflects is UNKNOWN — I wrote only the damage-prevention, which is stated. Whether Overwhelm stacks persist through her death is not in the kit text and was not asserted.
